# Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta2

This is the frontend half of the paired **Navimower 0.5.0-beta2** shadow-hardening release.

## Beta 2 scope

The backend stays in Canonical v2 shadow mode for one more field-validation cycle.
The Map Card deliberately keeps the proven 0.3.7 rendering/data contract while
CycleEngine parity is hardened from real X390, H215, H1500 and i108 diagnostics.

There is still no Map API v2 authority cutover in this beta. Current-cycle
resources, prepared live/history data, controls, Schedule, notifications, Gate
areas, underlays and Multi mower continue to use the existing public contract.

Use the matching pair:

- Navimower 0.5.0-beta2
- Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta2

The next paired beta can move to the canonical backend/resource contract once the
beta2 field diagnostics confirm compatibility parity.
